title: Voice Clues
objective: Use pitch and pauses to show the meaning of a sentence.
introduction: Your voice can ask, tell, or shout with surprise! 🐱✨ Help Milo make each sentence sound right.

vocabulary.definition: A question sentence that ends with a question mark.
A telling sentence that gives information and ends with a period.
An exclamation sentence that ends with an exclamation mark.

items.explanation: “Are you ready?” ends with a question mark, so readers know to read it as a question.

items.prompt: Which sentence should be read in a calm, telling voice?
items.explanation: A telling sentence ends with a period, so “I am ready.” is read calmly.

items.prompt: Which sentence shows excitement with its end mark?
items.explanation: “What a surprise!” ends with an exclamation mark, so it is read with excitement.

items.prompt: Which sentence should end with a period?
items.explanation: Only “Please listen.” is a calm telling sentence, so it ends with a period.
The question mark on “Are you ready?” tells readers to raise their voice at the end.
